description: List recent entries from the Nextcloud activity feed (file changes, shares, comments, calendar/contact edits, etc.) for the current user.

filter.description: Which feed to read: 'all' (default), 'self' (your own actions), or 'by' (others' actions)

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default 50)

since.description: Return activities after this activity_id (for pagination)

sort.description: Sort order by time: 'desc' (newest first, default) or 'asc'

name: list_activity
title: List Activity
